interpretation: Nominal detector/distance and rounded coefficients cannot prove the candidate ANH was active or valid. The CSV DI field has unverified units/meaning and differs numerically from report detector thickness. QG does not print the active efficiency-file/certificate identity; source volumes/orientations and timing corrections remain unqualified. Clocks are never timezone-corrected. No efficiency fraction, Bq, EOI or C/E is computed.
